comment: Neighborhood search index for the plan table. Streets marked 'plan-names' are anchored by the municipality's own plan names in the dataset (the neighborhood appears next to the street in a published plan name); 'manual' entries are hand-checked. Streets shared by several neighborhoods are excluded on purpose - הפלמ"ח is anchored to קטמון, קטמון הישנה and קרית שמואל with unknown number ranges, so it maps to none. קרית שמואל has no uniquely anchored street yet; its plans are still found by the free-text name match.
